# Dual Anchor Model (DAM)

> Closed-form valuation screen for high-growth firms. Capitalizes next-period net income and adds a revenue-growth term that stays finite when growth exceeds the discount rate. A heuristic, not a discounted-cash-flow model and not a buy or sell recommendation.

Reference case α = 1, with g and r as decimals. Negative g is set to zero in the second term only:

V_0 = NI_1 / r + Rev_1 · g / r

g is expected revenue growth at the moment, over the coming year. When sources differ, g is the revenue-weighted sum of each source's own current growth. It is not a perpetual or terminal rate; the model already fades growth.

Follow the skill for inputs, the general α formula, the output format, and the limits of the screen.

## Apply

- [Dual Anchor Model skill](skills/dual-anchor-model/SKILL.md): Procedure for computing and interpreting a DAM screen.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Entry point for coding agents in this repository.

## Paper

- [README](README.md): Summary, backtest pattern, and how to point an agent here.
- [Dual Anchor Model (PDF)](Dual_Anchor_Model.pdf): Derivation, historical backtest, and comparisons with PEG and Gordon growth.
- [Choosing the Growth Rate (PDF)](Choosing_the_Growth_Rate.pdf): Which g belongs in the model. Current expected revenue growth, or a revenue-source buildup. Not a perpetual rate.
- [LaTeX source](Dual_Anchor_Model.tex): Source for the main note.
- [Growth-rate source](Choosing_the_Growth_Rate.tex): Source for the companion note.
